get.description:
- Open to everyone.
- Redirects to Swagger documentation.

post.description:
- Open to everyone.
- Registers a new user with validation and uniqueness checks.
- Passwords are peppered, salted, and stored as hashes.
- A logged-in user cannot sign up until the session expires or is terminated.

- Open to everyone.
- Authenticates registered user,
sets a JWT access token with a session ID in cookies,
and creates a session.
- A logged-in user cannot log in again
until the session expires or is terminated.
- Authentication renews automatically
when accessing protected routes before expiration.
- If the JWT is invalid, expired, or the session is terminated,
the user loses authentication.

put.description:
- Open to authenticated users.
- The current user can change their password.
- New password must differ from current password.

delete.description:
- Open to authenticated users.
- Logs the user out by deleting the JWT access token from cookies
and removing the session from the database.

get.description:
- Open to everyone.
- Returns `200 OK` if the API is alive.

- Returns survey template list with latest published version references.

post.description:
- Open to survey operators.
- Creates a survey template with draft questions.
- Published versions are created by a dedicated publish operation.

get.description:
- Open to survey operators.
- Returns template draft detail and latest published version reference.

patch.description:
- Open to survey operators.
- Updates template draft data without mutating published versions.

post.description:
- Open to survey operators.
- Creates an immutable published version from current template draft.

get.description:
- Open to survey operators.
- Returns assignment list with progress fields.

post.description:
- Open to survey operators.
- Creates a survey assignment for a published template version.

get.description:
- Open to survey operators.
- Returns assignment detail with progress fields.

post.description:
- Open to survey operators.
- Closes an in-progress assignment and marks it completed.

get.description:
- Open to authenticated assignment assignee.
- Returns the caller's latest submission snapshot.

put.description:
- Open to authenticated assignment assignee.
- Saves latest submission snapshot with overwrite semantics.

get.description:
- Open to survey operators.
- Returns latest effective submission details for an assignment.

get.description:

post.description:
- Open to admins.
- Creates a new user, including admins, if the username is unique.
- Only super admins can create new admins.

get.description:
- Open to admins.
- Retrieves a paginated list of existing users with relevant information.

put.description:
- Open to admins.
- Admins can set passwords of subordinate users.

- Open to super admins.
- Grants admin rights to a specified user.
- Super admin rights cannot be changed.

delete.description:
- Open to super admins.
- Revokes admin rights from a specified user.
- Super admin rights cannot be changed

put.description:
- Open to admins.
- Restores a previously soft-deleted user.
- Only super admins can activate other admins.

delete.description:
- Open to admins.
- Soft-deletes an existing user, making that user inactive.
- Also deletes the user's sessions.
- Only super admins can deactivate other admins.
- Super admins cannot be soft-deleted.
